recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: May bay spring: cool dawn, mercury climbing toward twenty-three, clear air and a long slow sunset
temporary constellations sketched on worn asphalt — bright tags where the street needs care
old stacks whispering while new ones learn their first heartbeat
frontier-model myth kept behind frosted glass — rumor itself becomes the weather
headphones full of stutter-house gates and Swedish pop softness in the same breath

composer-2-fast.concept: Stutter-house subway: you switch rails through gaps that only exist on the off-beat while ghost stems stack every eight bars.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm lane switch — move when the beat unlocks a corridor.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Swipe left/right on the downbeat window.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: A clean run when the track doubles feels like nailing a live remix in one thumb.
composer-2-fast.escalation: BPM creeps up and phantom lanes appear that vanish if you hesitate.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon waveform tunnel with leaking sub-bass bloom

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Guide sunrise along dew trails on a magnolia petal — light follows your drawn path and ignites pollen timers before wind smears the ink.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Trace paths for light; angle and length set timer chains.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Drag to paint a glow corridor, release to commit.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clearing the petal before virtual noon without scorching the edge.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Wind shears your line and adds rolling dew beads that break contact.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Macro watercolor petal with caustic sun shards

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Hold to spray soft halos around potholes scrolling under you; traffic must honor the paint or you bleed social heat.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Hold/release halo tagging on hazards in a scrolling road.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Hold to spray, release to lock the halo size.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Chaining perfect halos without overlaps before the block ends.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Night rain, faster traffic, tighter cluster of craters.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Chalk-pastel street at blue hour with headlight ribbons

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick floating agent badges into three gravity wells — Plan, Ship, Sleep — while a backlog hydra sprouts heads from leftovers.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Physics flick sorting with anti-gravity wells.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Flick badges toward bins; short flick vs long arc matters.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Emptying a wave with no stray heads feels like a micro dopamine deploy.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Heads multiply faster and decoy prompts appear matching two bins.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Glassy floating terminal with hologram task chips
